cover.concept: Four aligned but distinct layers—planner context, workspace bytes, durable attempt/provenance, and authority—converge on a narrow mutation boundary where an effect is either admitted or held.

inlineFigures.purpose: Show the difference between planner-visible evidence and execution-time authority enforcement, with actor/attempt/artifact/scope/evidence-version bindings crossing the mutation boundary.
inlineFigures.placement: after the Research Center synthesis section

claimBoundary: The figure is a Research Center conceptual synthesis based on the paper's separation of planner exposure and execution-time enforcement; it is not a reproduction of a paper figure and does not claim a standardized architecture.
